title: Inclusivity of AI Speech in Healthcare: A Decade Look Back

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing open-source ASR and TTS speech datasets for language coverage, regional accent diversity, and non-native speaker representation.

Evaluating gender balance and the representation of gender-diverse individuals in dataset metadata, alongside conducting a systematic literature search to quantify publications on gender bias in AI speech.
Assessing the inclusion of diverse age groups (e.g., older adults, children) in speech datasets and tracking the volume of age-related inclusivity research over a decade.
Examining dataset metadata for ethnic or racial composition reporting and analyzing the frequency of related research publications via academic database searches.
Checking speech datasets for the explicit inclusion of speech impairment samples (e.g., dysarthria, aphasia) and quantifying research literature focused on speech disabilities.
